scope_note: Agent evidence review on 2026-10-18 UTC inspected fresh main and recent batches, repository instructions, schemas, diagnostic standard, task claims, canonical records, tests, validators and CI. PHP unavailable locally; exact-head hosted workflows including PHP lint required before integration. Verification-before-completion gates publication. Operational task claim excluded from commits and released after merge. No production deployment. Remaining gaps: lesion-linked taxonomic/molecular specimens, cultivar-diverse serial image/video, infection timing, overwintering biology, field thresholds and independently reviewed training admission. Historical regional reports and likely spread routes do not establish an individual sample's infection date or source. Symptom-only, unmatched-surface, rights-unclear and causally unlinked captures retain review restrictions. Agent review is not actual human, expert or laboratory specimen confirmation.
